user.title: Add FreshAirIQ
user.description: FreshAirIQ can be added immediately without configuring any rooms. The outdoor-air source, rooms and all other settings are optional here and can be configured later under Devices & services under Devices & services → FreshAirIQ → Configure. Until the required climate sources are available, FreshAirIQ does not perform ventilation calculations, but the dashboard remains available.

data_description.outdoor_weather: Optional. Recommended source for outdoor air and weather forecasts. It can be added at any time after installation.
data_description.outdoor_temperature: Optional. Use only together with an outdoor humidity sensor.
data_description.outdoor_humidity: Optional. Use only together with an outdoor temperature sensor.
data_description.pollen_entity: Optional. Evaluated only when pollen consideration is enabled.

room.title: Add room
room.description: Settings for **{contact_name}** (`{contact_entity}`) – window/door {contact_position} of {contact_count}. Reference air, opening delay and compass orientation belong directly to this opening; shutter/blind and optional door special cases follow.

data_description.name: Custom display name, for example “Living room”. FreshAirIQ derives a stable internal room key from it.
data_description.temperature: Temperature sensor for the room. Required for calculated rooms; default: no preselection.
data_description.humidity: Humidity sensor for the room. Required for calculated rooms; default: no preselection.
data_description.contacts: Select all contacts through which FreshAirIQ should detect ventilation.
data_description.contact_mode: “At least one open” reacts to any selected contact; “All open” only to the shared ventilation path.
data_description.volume: Enter either the volume directly in m³ or complete dimensions.
data_description.length: Only required when no direct room volume is entered.
data_description.width: Only required when no direct room volume is entered.
data_description.height: Only required when no direct room volume is entered.
data_description.reference_temperature: Optional. Use a reference temperature only when the opening leads to an air zone other than normal outdoor air, e.g. a conservatory. Pair it with reference humidity from the same zone.
data_description.reference_humidity: Optional. Reference humidity from the same air zone as the reference temperature. FreshAirIQ uses both to calculate absolute humidity of incoming air.
data_description.delay_seconds: Time this contact must remain continuously open before FreshAirIQ detects ventilation. 0 s = immediately; 120 s = after two minutes.
data_description.orientation: Actual compass orientation of this opening. A window with morning sun is typically East. Improves wind and cross-ventilation assessment.
data_description.co2: Optional. With a CO₂ sensor, air quality becomes a regular ventilation goal. Without one, this room has no CO₂ priority, recommendation or CO₂ target display.
data_description.floor: Floor/area used for grouping and cross ventilation. Example: “Ground floor”. Default: not assigned.
data_description.include_in_calculations: Off = the room remains visible but is excluded from recommendations, house balance, statistics and learning.
data_description.moisture_sources: Multiple selection is possible: shower, bathtub, sauna, cooking, washing machine, dryer, ironing station and/or hung laundry. This is only context for detection; FreshAirIQ activates a moisture source only when the measurements support it.
data_description.voc: Optional. VOC/TVOC sensors measure volatile organic compounds, for example from cleaning products, furniture or cooking fumes. VOC/TVOC is not a CO₂ substitute and not a multi-goal ventilation target. It does not change humidity physics or the ml forecast; values can support air-quality/air-purifier guidance and 30-day diagnostics.
data_description.pm25: Optional. PM2.5 measures fine particulate matter up to 2.5 µm, typically in µg/m³. It is not a humidity or CO₂ ventilation target and does not change the ml forecast; it can support particulate/air-purifier guidance and 30-day diagnostics.
data_description.illuminance: Optional. Illuminance is measured in lux (lx). It does not change humidity, CO₂ or temperature ventilation goals or the ml forecast; it can support shading/comfort features and 30-day diagnostics.
data_description.covers: Optional room-climate input or intervention target. FreshAirIQ only recommends device actions by default; actuation requires an explicit Home Assistant action.
data_description.climate: Optional input. The room remains fully usable without a thermostat/climate device. If configured, FreshAirIQ uses its last plausible setpoint as the comfort target in automatic mode; humidity and other configured ventilation goals remain active.
data_description.exhaust_fan: Optional. Select an exhaust fan or mechanical ventilation entity. ON starts a mechanical ventilation session and OFF ends it. FreshAirIQ detects and learns this ventilation type; it does not switch the device automatically.
data_description.supply_fan: Optional. Supply-air device for fresh-air/air-quality context. It is not a separate priority goal and is not controlled automatically.
data_description.ventilation_device: Optional. Central or decentralized ventilation/HRV device as an alternative mechanical ventilation option. No automatic device control.
data_description.dehumidifier: Optional. Dehumidifier as an alternative when humidity is high or outdoor air is unsuitable. No automatic device control.
data_description.humidifier: Optional. Humidifier as an alternative when room air is clearly too dry. No automatic device control.
data_description.air_purifier: Optional. Air purifier as an additional measure for particulate matter, VOC or pollen. No automatic device control.
data_description.ventilation_threshold_mode: Automatic uses the established default room threshold. Percentage and fixed modes override it only for this room; health and safety rules take priority.
data_description.ventilation_threshold_percent: Percentage mode only: share of the current water content in this room air.
data_description.ventilation_threshold_ml: Fixed mode only: removable moisture potential from which this room may be prioritized individually.
data_description.goal_priorities: Order dehumidification, CO₂/air quality and temperature comfort for this room. All goals are evaluated in parallel; protection limits always take precedence.
data_description.target_temperature_mode: Automatic uses the plausible thermostat/climate setpoint. Manual uses the comfort temperature configured below.
data_description.target_temperature: Only for manual target temperature: desired comfort temperature from 12–30 °C.
data_description.target_temperature_fallback: Optional fallback when the thermostat/climate device provides no plausible setpoint, for example while it is switched off.

data_description.add_another: Default: on. Enabled = add another room; disabled = finish setup.

data_description.min_delta: Minimum difference between indoor absolute humidity and reference air for normal dehumidification.
data_description.min_delta_high_rh: Reduced minimum difference when room humidity is already high.
data_description.close_delta: If the remaining absolute-humidity difference is smaller, further ventilation usually provides little additional moisture removal.

recommendation_thresholds.name: Recommendation thresholds
recommendation_thresholds.description: Defines when enough removable water is available for a recommendation. Default: automatic home-size threshold.

data_description.min_potential_room_ml: A single problematic room can be prioritized from this removable potential onward, independently of the house total.

ventilation_timing.name: Ventilation duration & repetition
ventilation_timing.description: Time limits, stabilization and protection against overly frequent repeated recommendations.

data.repeat_min_benefit_ml: Minimum benefit for a repeated recommendation

data_description.min_duration_min: Before this point, FreshAirIQ normally does not recommend closing solely because additional benefit is declining.
data_description.max_duration_min: Upper limit for a normal ventilation recommendation. Safety/health logic may still react separately.
data_description.post_ventilation_stabilization_min: After closing, FreshAirIQ waits this long for sensor values and room air to stabilize before issuing a new recommendation.
data_description.repeat_recommendation_cooldown_min: Prevents the same recommendation from reappearing immediately after completed ventilation.
data_description.repeat_min_benefit_ml: A repeated recommendation during the cooldown period requires at least this much additional expected moisture benefit.

efficiency.name: Benefit & temperature loss
efficiency.description: Balances additional moisture removal against heat loss.

data_description.min_return_next_5_min_ml: Another five minutes should remove at least this additional amount of water; otherwise the benefit is considered too low.
data_description.max_temp_loss_next_5_min_c: Limits the additional temperature loss tolerated over the next five minutes.
data_description.min_efficiency_ml_per_01c: Evaluates how much moisture is removed per 0.1 °C of temperature loss.

health_limits.name: Mould & CO₂
health_limits.description: Limits for estimated surface humidity and CO₂ air quality.

data_description.surface_factor: Approximation factor for colder indoor surfaces. Lower values mean stronger assumed cooling toward outdoor temperature.
data_description.mould_warn_surface_rh: Above this estimated surface humidity, FreshAirIQ reports elevated mould risk.
data_description.mould_critical_surface_rh: Above this estimated surface humidity, mould risk is considered critical.
data_description.co2_warn: Above this CO₂ value, ventilation priority increases when a CO₂ sensor is available.
data_description.co2_critical: Above this CO₂ value, air quality is treated as critical.

learning.name: Learning model
learning.description: Controls whether and for how long FreshAirIQ uses valid ventilation sessions as learning samples.

data_description.learning_enabled: Enables persistent learning of air exchange, routines and forecast corrections. Default: on.
data_description.learning_max_duration_min: Longer sessions are not used as clean learning samples because weather, heating and occupancy effects increasingly dominate.

profile.title: Operating profile
profile.description: Choose the priority. FreshAirIQ then shows only the fine-tuning inputs relevant to that profile.

data_description.operating_profile: Dehumidify = moisture removal has priority. Comfort = balanced decision. Summer cooling = passive cooling with acceptable moisture risk.

house.title: Property & occupants
house.description: Household, presence and night model. Residents with a phone can be assigned through person/device_tracker entities; residents without phones remain supported.

data.untracked_follow_household: Residents without trackers follow household presence

data_description.property_type: Distinguishes detached house, semi-detached house, mid/end-terrace house, apartment, attic apartment, maisonette and multi-family building, among others.
data_description.adult_occupants: Used together with learned values for daytime and overnight forecasts.
data_description.child_occupants: Children receive their own lower moisture contribution in the initial model.
data_description.night_start_hour: Convenient time selection instead of a numeric hour.
data_description.night_end_hour: End of the time window for which the overnight forecast is calculated and learned.
data_description.night_forecast_enabled: Enables the overnight forecast and adaptive night model.
data_description.adult_presence_entities: Assign the primary person/device_tracker entities to adult residents. Multiple residents can be selected.
data_description.child_presence_entities: Optional for children with their own tracker. Children without a tracker are still handled by household logic.
data_description.presence_sensor_entities: You can select any suitable available binary_sensor entities. They are soft supporting evidence; a single motion event is not automatically treated as confirmed human presence.
data_description.pet_safe_presence_entities: Sensors from the selection above that reliably detect real human presence even with pets. These signals may be weighted more strongly in pet mode.
data_description.pets_in_household: Enable when pets can trigger motion sensors. Conventional motion sensors are then weighted much less strongly to avoid phantom occupants.
data_description.untracked_follow_household: If at least one relevant tracker is definitely home, residents without trackers may be assumed present. If all relevant trackers are definitely away, they may be assumed absent. Uncertain states are handled conservatively.
data_description.adult_resident_names: Separate names with commas and enter them in the same order as the adult trackers. If Paul is selected first and Lydia second above, enter “Paul, Lydia”. Residents without their own tracker may be added, e.g. “Paul, Lydia, Grandma”. Names stay local and are used only for understandable personal assignment.
data_description.child_resident_names: Separate names with commas and enter them in the same order as the child trackers, e.g. “Fiona, Maya”. Children without their own tracker may also be named. Names stay local; FreshAirIQ does not use them for direct action requests to children.

energy.title: Heating system
energy.description: Select the heating system used to estimate reheating costs. Default: heat pump. The next step shows only the applicable cost parameters.

data_description.heating_system: Used only for reheating-cost calculations. Example: for a heat pump, electricity price and COP/SCOP are used. Default: heat pump.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Default: notifications off, no recipients, scope “House”, all rooms, ventilate/close/completion/cooling/mould/sensor-error notifications on, night/learning off, minimum interval 90 minutes.

data_description.notifications_enabled: Master switch for all FreshAirIQ push notifications.
data_description.notification_targets: Select existing notify.* services. No push notifications are sent without a recipient.
data_description.notification_scope: House = central recommendations. Room = room-specific messages. Both = both levels.
data_description.notification_room_keys: Empty means all rooms. A selection limits room-specific messages to those rooms.
data_description.notification_cooldown_min: Prevents repeated identical notifications within this period.
data_description.notify_close: Sends a notification when further air exchange no longer provides enough benefit or comfort limits are reached. Default: on.
data_description.notify_complete: Sends the measured result after a completed ventilation session. Default: on.
data_description.notify_cooling: Reports favourable windows for passive summer cooling. Default: on.
data_description.notify_learning: Reports relevant learning progress. Default: off.
data_description.notify_mould: Warns about relevant estimated surface/mould risk. Default: on.
data_description.notify_night: Sends night-strategy hints. Default: off, so FreshAirIQ does not notify unexpectedly at night.
data_description.notify_sensor: Warns when sensor data required for a reliable recommendation is missing or implausible. Default: on.
data_description.notify_ventilate: Sends a notification when FreshAirIQ detects a useful time to start ventilation. Default: on.
data_description.suppress_notifications_at_night: When enabled, FreshAirIQ sends no push notifications during the configured night window. Calculations, ventilation logic and learning continue unchanged.
data_description.test_notification_now: Enable and confirm to immediately send a neutral test message to all currently selected recipients. This action is not saved.

statistics.title: Statistics
statistics.description: FreshAirIQ can show 1–365 days of compact daily ventilation and climate aggregates. High-resolution temperature points remain limited to 30 days for performance.

data_description.statistics_days: Allowed range: 1–365 days. Compact daily ventilation and climate aggregates are retained long term; high-resolution temperature points remain limited to 30 days.

reset_learning.title: Reset learning
reset_learning.description: Deletes learned room air-exchange values, routines and the night model. Room configuration, options and statistics remain intact.

data_description.confirm: Default: off. Deletes only learned models; rooms, sensor assignments and global options remain.

sort_rooms.title: Sort rooms
sort_rooms.description: Select a room and move it with ↑ or ↓. The displayed order is updated after each confirmed move.

data_description.room_to_move: Choose the room whose position you want to change. Its current position is shown before the room name.
data_description.move_direction: ↑ moves the room exactly one position up, ↓ exactly one position down. You can then continue sorting.

contact_delays_room.title: Choose room
contact_delays_room.description: Configure opening delay separately for every contact.

data_description.room: Select the room whose window/door contacts should receive an opening delay. Example: count a basement door as ventilation only after 120 s.

contact_delays.title: Opening delays · {room_name}
contact_delays.description: Time a contact must remain continuously open before FreshAirIQ starts a ventilation session. Default: 0 s. Example: 120 s ignores brief door openings and counts the contact as ventilation only after two minutes.

air_quality.title: Optional sensors & outdoor air
air_quality.description: VOC/TVOC, PM2.5 and illuminance are fully optional. They do not change humidity/ventilation physics, the ml forecast or the learning model. When enabled, they may produce supplemental recommendations and are included in the local 30-day diagnostics for future feature development. Pollen and wind remain separate outdoor-air influences.

data.wind_orientation_enabled: Use window orientation with wind data
data.cover_learning_max_closed_percent: Maximum closed blind/shutter for learning samples (%)

data_description.pollen_enabled: Requires a pollen-index sensor under the outdoor-air source.
data_description.pollen_max: Above this index, normal ventilation is postponed when the veto is active; critical mould/CO₂ risk remains prioritized.
data_description.pollen_strict_veto: Off = pollen is displayed but does not block a recommendation.
data_description.wind_orientation_enabled: Uses only available local wind data; without wind direction the factor remains neutral.
data_description.voc_warn: Threshold for optional VOC/TVOC-based supplemental recommendations. It does not change canonical ventilation calculations.
data_description.voc_critical: Critical VOC threshold for diagnostics and future prioritisation. It does not change the existing ventilation physics.
data_description.pm25_warn: Threshold for optional PM2.5-based supplemental recommendations. It does not change canonical ventilation calculations.
data_description.pm25_critical: Critical PM2.5 threshold for diagnostics and future prioritisation. It does not change the existing ventilation physics.
data_description.humidify_below_rh: Only used when a room humidifier is configured.
data_description.shade_above_temp_c: Only used when covers/blinds are configured.
data_description.shade_min_illuminance_lx: Used only when illuminance input is enabled. It refines existing shading recommendations; ventilation calculations remain unchanged.
data_description.voc_sensor_enabled: Off = configured VOC/TVOC sensors are not read, shown or used for supplemental recommendations. The room assignment remains stored.
data_description.pm25_sensor_enabled: Off = configured PM2.5 sensors are not read, shown or used for supplemental recommendations. The room assignment remains stored.
data_description.illuminance_sensor_enabled: Off = configured illuminance sensors are not read, shown or used to refine shading recommendations. The room assignment remains stored.
data_description.cover_position_zero_means: Defines how FreshAirIQ interprets blind/shutter position values. Choose the direction that makes the calculated closed percentage match the physical blind/shutter.
data_description.cover_learning_max_closed_percent: If a blind/shutter assigned to the open window or door is closed beyond this value, ventilation is still detected and balanced but is excluded from learning. Partial shading changes airflow and can bias the learning model. Default: 20%.

energy_details.title: Heating costs · {heating_system}
energy_details.description: These values are used only to estimate the cost of reheating the heat lost through ventilation. The default values are approximations and can be adjusted to your tariff or heating system.

data_description.heat_pump_cop: The higher the COP/seasonal performance factor, the less electricity is required for reheating.
data_description.gas_efficiency: Usable share of the purchased gas energy.
data_description.oil_kwh_per_liter: Typical heating value; can be adjusted to the fuel being used.
data_description.district_efficiency: Accounts for distribution losses inside the home. 1.00 = no loss; default: 0.98.
data_description.electricity_price_per_kwh: Your electricity energy price. Example: €0.30/kWh. Used for heat pumps and electric heating.
data_description.oil_efficiency: Usable share of the heat energy contained in heating oil. Default: 0.88.

profile_details.title: Operating profile · {profile}
profile_details.description: Dehumidify tolerates somewhat more temperature loss for effective moisture removal. Comfort balances moisture and energy. Summer cooling uses cooling-specific parameters only.

data.cooling_min_outdoor_delta_c: Outdoor air at least this much cooler
data.cooling_max_moisture_gain_5min_ml: Maximum tolerated moisture gain in 5 min

data_description.cooling_max_indoor_rh: Above this indoor humidity, cooling is not prioritised at the cost of additional moisture. Default: 70%.
data_description.cooling_max_moisture_gain_5min_ml: Maximum accepted predicted moisture gain during five minutes of cooling. Default: 60 ml.
data_description.cooling_min_outdoor_delta_c: Outdoor air must be at least this much cooler. Default: 2 °C.
data_description.cooling_start_temp_c: Summer cooling is prioritised only above this room temperature. Default: 24 °C.
data_description.max_temp_loss_next_5_min_c: Maximum tolerated additional room-temperature loss over the next five minutes. Example: 0.6 °C in Comfort mode.
data_description.min_efficiency_ml_per_01c: Minimum ratio of moisture removal to temperature loss. Example: 8 ml per 0.1 °C.
data_description.min_return_next_5_min_ml: Minimum additional moisture removal FreshAirIQ expects over the next five minutes. Example: 25 ml in Comfort mode.

contact_orientations_room.title: Orientation per window/door
contact_orientations_room.description: Choose the room. The next step lets you assign an individual orientation to each ventilation contact.

data_description.room: Select the room. Each ventilation contact can then receive its own compass direction, for example South or North-East.

contact_orientations.title: Windows/doors · {room_name}
contact_orientations.description: Assign the actual compass orientation to each contact. Default: Unknown. Example: a window facing the morning sun = East; the opposite window = West. This information improves wind and cross-ventilation assessment.

reset_defaults.title: Restore defaults
reset_defaults.description: Restores all FreshAirIQ options to documented defaults. Rooms, sensors and statistics remain unchanged.

data_description.action: Floors and zones are user-defined, including mezzanines, annexes, conservatories or outdoor areas.

level_add.title: Add zone
level_add.description: Choose any name, for example “Ground floor”, “Basement”, “Conservatory” or “Extension”. Default: empty.

data_description.name: Custom display name. Example: “Ground floor”, “Basement”, “Conservatory” or “Extension”. Default: empty.

level_reorder.title: Sort zones
level_reorder.description: Each area receives a position number. Default: current order. A lower number places it higher.

data_description.level_order: Assign each area a position number. Example: Ground floor = 1, Upper floor = 2. Lower numbers appear first.

level_remove.title: Remove zone
level_remove.description: Only unused zones can be removed.

data_description.name: Select an unused area. Areas that still contain rooms must first be removed from those rooms.

cross_ventilation.title: Cross ventilation
cross_ventilation.description: Define only real airflow paths where two rooms opened at the same time can create effective cross ventilation. Default: empty, so no additional cross-ventilation bonus. Available room keys: {room_keys}

data_description.cross_ventilation_pairs: Format: room_a+room_b. Separate multiple pairs with commas. Example: living_room+bedroom,office+child_room. A bonus applies only when both associated ventilation contacts are active.
data_description.cross_zone_connections: Only required when a cross-ventilation pair is physically connected across different floors/areas. Same format. Example: living_room+gym. Pairs within the same area need no entry here.

personalisation.description: Adapts wording and comfort context to your household. Physical forecasts and health, mould and CO₂ safety limits remain unchanged. Defaults: enabled, balanced, automatic night handling.

data_description.personalisation_enabled: Uses household context and learned behaviour only for more suitable recommendations.
data_description.thermal_preference: Warm, balanced or cool. Safety decisions are never weakened.
data_description.personal_priority: Indoor climate, balanced or energy saving. Applies only within the comfort layer.
data_description.night_window_preference: Automatic, prefer closed at night, or open at night is acceptable.

contact_references.title: {room_name} · {contact_name}
contact_references.description: Settings for **{contact_name}** (`{contact_entity}`) – window/door {contact_position} of {contact_count}. Reference air, opening delay and compass orientation belong directly to this opening; shutter/blind and optional door special cases follow.

data.passage_door: Passage door – pulled shut from outside after passing through

data_description.reference_temperature: Optional. Use a reference temperature only when the opening leads to an air zone other than normal outdoor air, e.g. a conservatory. Pair it with reference humidity from the same zone.
data_description.reference_humidity: Optional. Reference humidity from the same air zone as the reference temperature. FreshAirIQ uses both to calculate absolute humidity of incoming air.
data_description.delay_seconds: Time this contact must remain continuously open before FreshAirIQ detects ventilation. 0 s = immediately; 120 s = after two minutes.
data_description.orientation: Actual compass orientation of this opening. A window with morning sun is typically East. Improves wind and cross-ventilation assessment.
data_description.covers: Optional. Blind or shutter directly assigned to this specific window or door.
data_description.passage_door: Example: You step outside to smoke on the terrace or balcony and only pull the door shut from outside. **Enable only if this door has a genuine three-state contact sensor installed in the door hardware** that detects the handle or hardware position. data_description.cover_position_zero_means: Choose whether 0% means fully closed or fully open. This setting applies to blinds/shutters assigned to this room.

threshold.description: Choose how FreshAirIQ determines the house ventilation threshold. Automatic (recommended): expected daily moisture generation is divided by four and constrained to 6–12% of currently monitored water. From May through September the threshold is reduced by 25% before 09:00 and from 19:00 when outside air is at least 2°C cooler than average indoor temperature. Health, mould and critical CO₂ rules take priority.

diagnostics_sharing.title: Diagnostics sharing

FreshAirIQ prepares the technically complete retained diagnostics history locally for analysis, removes or pseudonymises direct identifiers, and transfers large histories in chunks. After the first acknowledged full sync, only new diagnostic records are transferred. This staging configuration connects only to the local Diagnostics Hub on the private LAN. The beta preset is Nightly; any later public deployment will require HTTPS.
